home.heroBody: From pre-school to high school, {{name}} combines strong academics, character education and modern technology to prepare every child for university and life.
home.programsSubtitle: Three stages, one continuous journey from early childhood to university entrance.
home.programPreschool: Phonics, numeracy through play, Amharic and English, motor skills, music and care in small classes with dedicated assistants.
home.programMiddle: Literacy, mathematics, science labs, ICT, civics and clubs, with continuous assessment and a parent conference every term.
home.programHigh: University entrance preparation with science laboratories, career guidance, Olympiad coaching and exam practice.
home.whySubtitle: Four things that make {{name}} a different kind of school.
home.whyAcademicsBody: Qualified teachers, a proper laboratory and library, and results we are happy to show you.
home.whyCharacterBody: Respect, honesty, teamwork and responsibility are taught and reported on, not just preached.
home.whyTechBody: Digital literacy and an ICT centre prepare students for a university and a digital workplace.
home.whyCareBody: Small classes, a school nurse, meals and counselling, and parents who hear from us early.
home.quickAccessSubtitle: The things families need most, one click away.
home.quickApplyBody: Start an application in a few minutes.
